_doc: School rules. Code decides WHEN a rule is being broken (js/systems/rules.js has one predicate per id); this file decides who cares, how bad it is and what happens. seenBy: which watchers react (teacher, prefect, staff = house master/principal/librarian/gateman, student = coursemates who may gossip). sev: 0 = on-the-spot punishment, 1-3 = offence on your file. rep: reputation changes when caught. rumour: what people say afterwards ({name} = you). escort: where you get marched to.
